items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: her brother, I met him when he first came out of the service in 1946

ctx.x: So, as fate would have it, I got a gig playing after searching all over Los Angeles, and I couldn't find the child or her mother, and no one seemed to know where she was or what happened to her, and I got a job on New Year's Eve with the Bob Crosby Orchestra to play at a hotel in Phoenix, Arizona.

And while riding on the plane, it came to me that the mother of the child in California -- her brother, I met him when he first came out of the service in 1946, and he and his wife were going to Phoenix, Arizona to live. So I

got off the plane, and I asked the skycap this guy for him, and I used his name and asked for him, and this young man said to me, he said, 'Why, he is the exalted ruler of my lodge' -- he meant the Elks.
